## Activity

During December 2020, Central Eye Clinic recorded 83 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and provides the associated image quality and grading results. The capture total represents the imaging activity completed at the site during the reporting period. The results below distinguish between images that could be assessed and those that could not be graded.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 1.2 per cent. The ungradable result is reported separately from the overall capture total to support review of image quality and any follow-up required. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 22 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to completion of grading was 2 days. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during December 2020. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a concise record of service performance at Central Eye Clinic for the reporting month.
